text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, we'll be taking on the Sprinters
Stakes for
the second time.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O, Yamanin Zephyr...
There are
some strong contenders in the
lineup this year!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec! You forgot about Nishino
Flower!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Speaking of, she's had a new
game face
on recently that really speaks
to her growth.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for her to show us how much
further
she's come!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Can you say the stuff you always tell me
before a
race, please?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: 君は最高に、かっこいい！
貴方は最高に、かっこいい！
choice_data_list_en: You are at your absolute coolest!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Can I ask you for a selfish favor?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go bloom into a huge
flower, and
when I come back...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to praise me and tell me I'm
beautiful!
